text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: spike in 5xx from control-plane dependencies (auth + org-lookup) observed across prod clusters. Paging oncall now.

tilly (SRE): i'm on it. seeing elevated 502/504 traces hitting gateway -> auth-proxy -> org-lookup. traffic spike at 18:02 UTC.

mike (eng): reproduction from my side: requests to /v1/org/lookup are timing out at ~1.2s then cascade to gateway 502. Putting a quick query to datadog now.

sarah (prodops): customer-reported errors starting ~18:00. a handful of big customers in EU/US-east seeing latency + errors on inference control-plane calls. marking priority-high.

andrew (oncall): adding mitigation suggestions: 1) flip auth-proxy circuit-breaker to fast-fail, 2) increase org-lookup cache hit TTL temporarily, 3) route non-critical requests to degraded path. who can run the commands?

dev-ops: i'm patching a temporary cache TTL bump for org-lookup from 15s -> 300s on the config service now. will update.

mike (eng): logs snapshot:```
2026-03-15T18:01:59Z auth-proxy ERROR upstream_timeout id=abcd123 path=/v1/org/lookup latency=1204ms
2026-03-15T18:02:05Z gateway WARNING downstream_502 trace=xyz status=502
```

tilly (SRE): run this to enable circuit breaker fast-fail on auth-proxy:```
# enable fast-fail via feature flag
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  https://config.internal/api/flags/auth-proxy/circuit_fast_fail -d '{"enabled":true}'
```

mike (eng): applied a route-level fallback to the legacy auth replica set for non-org-critical paths. monitoring error rate.

sarah (prodops): initial customer impact: approx 12-18% of control-plane API calls are getting 5xx; top affected endpoints: /v1/generate (incidental), /v1/org/lookup. region impact: eu-west-1 and us-east-1. informing CS to open high priority tickets.

incident_manager: please prepare external comms: short note for status.redwood.ai: root cause suspected auth/org-lookup contention causing timeouts -> gateway 502s. mitigation steps in progress.

andrew (oncall): i'm going to escalate to billing and config teams since org-lookup touches billing lookup in path. @mike can you add an emergency annotation to call out billing too?

mike (eng): added billing-team tag to the oncall rotation. pinged billing on pager.

tilly (SRE): quick health-checks:```
# probe org-lookup health
curl -sS -D - https://org-lookup.internal/health | head -n 20
# check kv cache stats
curl -sS https://cache-internal/metrics | grep org_lookup_hit_rate
```

dev-ops: cache TTL bump deployed. org-lookup hit rate jumped from 22% -> 78% within 30s. errors dropped to ~6% in eu-west.

mike (eng): pushed a small patch to add backpressure on auth-proxy connection pool and scaled up org-lookup horizontal pods by +3 while we investigate N+1 fanout. rolling out now.```

tilly (SRE): scaling looks stable. errors down to 4.8% across regions. observing a long-tail of retries from some customers hitting billing lookups - we'll prune retries by enforcing idempotency window.

incident_manager: current status for notes: impact limited but customer-facing. mitigation steps: cache TTL bump, circuit-fast-fail toggle, fallback routing, pod scale-up. next steps: root cause debugging + permanent fix.

andrew (oncall): preparing handoff to night oncall in 40m. will include runbook steps and links. adding checklist:
- confirm circuit-fast-fail remains enabled
- ensure cache TTL rollback guidance is documented
- confirm billing lookups are queued not retried aggressively
- contact top 3 affected customers with ETA

sarah (prodops): drafting customer comms now, will share update in #customer-impact for review.

mike (eng): for root cause: initial traces show org-lookup was experiencing a memory pressure GC pause causing request latency spikes, which created connection pileups at auth-proxy and then gateway 502s. collecting heap dumps and metrics for postmortem.

tilly (SRE): good mitigation. leaving a watch on this thread. if error rate creeps back above 7% re-pager oncall.

incident_manager: handing off to night shift. oncall for night is tilly (SRE) -> assigned. please update thread with any regression.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Incident status: mitigated -> degraded. active monitoring. incident channel set to quiet mode for now.
